description: This source file defines a static class 'GetIntellisenseEndpoint' that sets up an HTTP endpoint for serving a JavaScript file used for Liquid template intellisense, including cache management and script generation.

classes.name: GetIntellisenseEndpoint
classes.description: A static class providing methods to add an endpoint for Liquid intellisense script, handle caching, and generate script content.

methods.name: AddGetIntellisenseScriptEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the route to serve the liquid-intellisense.js script, allowing anonymous access and disabling antiforgery.

methods.name: HashCacheBustingValues
methods.description: Computes a hash based on the script version, filters, and tags to facilitate cache busting.

methods.name: HandleRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to serve the script, utilizing caching and setting appropriate cache headers.

methods.name: GenerateScriptBytes
methods.description: Generates the JavaScript content as a byte array, embedding filter and tag data.
